QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] The Covenant
QuestInfo.0: Prague offers to create a covenant on the conditions that if you do him a favor, he'll tell you the identity of the caller. Given his past, it would be risky, but there may be no other way...
QuestInfo.1: Prague asks you to bring him items hidden at various altars in the city. Investigate each altar.
QuestInfo.2: You found the items Prague was looking for. You got a bad feeling, though...

default.0: Must I remind you? I require those specific items.
